# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 83 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49 | Coptic

---

## Saying 83

Jesus said: "The images are manifest to the human being, but the light within them is hidden in the image of the light of the Father. He will become manifest, and his image will be hidden by his light."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- **ϩⲓⲕⲱⲛ** / *hikōn*: "image" — Greek *eikōn*; the visible form/representation
- "Images are manifest to the human being" — visible forms are apparent; but the light within is concealed
- "The light of the Father" — the divine source of all light
- "He will become manifest" — the Father will be revealed; his image concealed by his light
- The paradox: revelation conceals (too much light blinds); manifestation through hiddenness
- The image/light dialectic is distinctively Thomasine and Platonic
